understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every goal by stepping onto each goal cell while the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements. Completing all goals advances through the levels until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and blocked directions must never be attempted because they waste stamina without moving. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles cycle the corresponding piece attributes; rotation advances clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°, while color cycles orange, blue, green, red. A goal activates only when all three attributes match, and stepping onto it completes it. When stamina reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets to maximum; losing all lives ends the game.
